mintAuthority.summary: WEUSD is minted and redeemed through PicWe's omni-chain protocol via AccessControl tokens whose live BSC/Base/Arbitrum roles resolve to a PicWe admin/minter EOA plus a mint/redeem contract; the basket-style backing (roughly 9 USDT + 1 MOVE) explains the persistent ~$0.91 trading level.

sources.label: Movement Aptos REST — WEUSD package registry

controls.label: PicWe WEUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: BSC block 103632076: hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) both returned true; eth_getCode returned empty (EOA confirmed). Same role checks on Base block 47201470 and Plume block 74174478 also returned true. Movement: the Movement contract (0xf39c2674...) uses a different architecture — minting is controlled by the deployer EOA (0xf39c267... auth key = own address, sequence_number = 3, normal EOA) through admin-gated functions in weusd_mint_redeem and weusd_cross_chain_gas modules, consistent with the same PicWe admin.

controls.label: PicWe WEUSD mint/redeem contract (EVM chains)
controls.evidence: BSC block 103632076: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) returned true. Same check on Base block 47201470 and Plume block 74174478 returned true. No modules or guards detected in EVM Safe API checks.

controls.label: PicWe WEUSD Movement package publisher
controls.evidence: Movement REST reports an authentication key equal to the publishing account and package picwe at upgrade_number 0 with compatible upgrade policy 1. This account can publish compatible replacements for weusd, weusd_mint_redeem, and weusd_cross_chain_gas with no on-chain timelock. The EVM WEUSD contracts on BSC, Base, Arbitrum, and Plume have zero EIP-1967 implementation slots and are not proxies; PicWe's April 2026 directory separately lists the upgradeable investment modules and does not classify the WEUSD core contracts as proxies.

controls.label: PicWe WEUSD Movement cross-chain minter
controls.evidence: Movement Aptos REST: weusd_cross_chain_gas::GlobalManage.cross_mint_role_contract = 0x86e5136... (auth key matches address, sequence_number = 142, active operational relayer EOA). batchMintWeUSDCrossChain is gated on this address. The weusd::mint function is internal to the resource account (signer_capability_offer burned auth key at 0x16bb553...) — minting flows through weusd_mint_redeem and weusd_cross_chain_gas modules. Module upgrade controlled by deployer EOA 0xf39c267... (normal EOA, upgrade policy = 1).

review.evidence: BSC/Base/Arbitrum/Plume role checks confirmed EOA 0xc122... as DEFAULT_ADMIN+MINTER_ROLE holder and mint/redeem contract 0x5D54... as MINTER_ROLE holder; the new PicWe contract directory independently lists the same token and mint/redeem addresses on Arbitrum. EIP-1967 implementation slots are zero on the reviewed EVM contracts. Movement REST reports cross_mint_role_contract 0x86e5136... and a publisher-controlled package with compatible upgrade policy 1. All tracked chains and the distinct Movement upgrade path are resolved; no multisig or timelock was found. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer EOAs and an undelayed Movement upgrade path permit unbounded minting, while conflicting multi-chain reserve data has no whole-supply attestation and no prudential supervisor.
